title: Mission contribution body
description: The verifier records that a contributor did `units` of the mission's work (register row DK1240; spec-delta S1612): the unit is whatever the goal counts (a patch, a test, an hour of compute) and the shares are units against the sum. Signed by the mission's verifier (mission_contribution_wrong_issuer); the contributor needs a passport (mission_contributor_unknown); refused after settlement (mission_settled). Units add up when a contributor is recorded again. Chain: none (prev is null).
